function.name: set_alarm
function.description: Set an alarm (wake me up) at a clock time, on a date if one is given.

time.description: clock time in 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 07:30 for 7:30 am or 19:30 for 7:30 pm

function.name: remove_alarm
function.description: Remove (cancel, delete, turn off) the alarm set at a clock time, on a date if one is given.

time.description: clock time in 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 07:30 for 7:30 am or 19:30 for 7:30 pm

function.name: add_list_item
function.description: Add one item to the shopping list, the to-do list or the packing list.

list.description: shopping (grocery, groceries), to-do (to do, tasks) or packing (trip, travel)

item.description: the one item, in the user's words, e.g. two bottles of milk

function.name: remove_list_item
function.description: Remove (take off, delete) one item from the shopping list, the to-do list or the packing list.

list.description: shopping (grocery, groceries), to-do (to do, tasks) or packing (trip, travel)

item.description: the one item, in the user's words, e.g. two bottles of milk

function.name: create_reminder
function.description: Create a reminder (remind me, don't let me forget) at a clock time on a date.

text.description: what to be reminded about, in the user's words, e.g. take the bins out

time.description: clock time in 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 07:30 for 7:30 am or 19:30 for 7:30 pm
